# TidyByte

> Free iOS app that lets you swipe to delete junk photos, find duplicates, compress videos, and clean up your photo library — all 100% on-device, no account required.

TidyByte is a free, open-source iPhone photo cleanup app (iOS 17+). It uses a Tinder-style swipe interface to let users quickly review and delete unwanted photos. It also includes smart cleanup tools for duplicates, similar photos, blurry shots, screenshots, large files, burst photos, Live Photos, and video/photo compression. All processing uses Apple's Photos and Vision frameworks — no data ever leaves the device. There are no ads, no subscriptions, no in-app purchases, and no third-party dependencies.

## Key Facts

- Price: Free forever, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions
- Platform: iPhone (iOS 17+), runs on iPad in compatibility mode
- Privacy: 100% on-device processing, no backend, no analytics, no network calls
- Architecture: Built with Swift/SwiftUI, Apple frameworks only, no third-party dependencies
- License: MIT open source
- Repository: https://github.com/360ghar/snap-clean-ios
- Download: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/tidybyte/id6775769763
